After a soft breach on a funded account, the account is not closed. The current payout is still processed at a 30% reward share, and the payout cycle restarts from payout 1, which also restarts the fee-refund count. If it happens again after the warning, the account can be reset and its profit forfeited. In evaluation, the team may reset the account using a free retry if you still have one.

In some cases the reward is paid back to the original payment method, and you are told before it is sent.
